# Greek form codes in this file put voice before mood: V-[tense][voice][mood]-[person][number]. Example: V-AAI-3S = verb, aorist active indicative, 3rd singular (the Berean table writes the same form V-AIA-3S). A leading 2 means a second form of the tense (2A = second aorist). Voice: A active, M middle, P passive, E either middle or passive, D/O/N deponent kinds. Mood: I indicative, S subjunctive, O optative, M imperative, N infinitive, P participle. In the editions column, a word listed for TR or Byz but not NA28 is absent from the primary text.
